summary: A functional prototype with steep San Francisco hills, row houses, and active laser tag combat between autonomous cars, but severely hindered by a washed-out white fog, unresponsive menu blocking initial inputs, blocky car models, lack of recognizable SF landmarks, and a steep framerate drop.

top_issues.issue: Heavy white fog and overexposed lighting wash out the entire scene, obscuring buildings beyond a block away and eliminating crisp contrast.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 1-5 show a thick white haze starting very close to the camera, washing out the pastel row houses on the left and right and hiding the background skyline completely.
top_issues.fix_hint: Remove or drastically push back the white distance fog, use a clear sunny skybox, and reduce bloom/ambient light intensity so building colors and distant street geometry remain crisp.

top_issues.issue: Zero recognizable San Francisco landmarks are visible anywhere in the scene.
top_issues.evidence: Across the entire gameplay video (00:02-00:42) and Screenshots 1-5, only generic row houses and hill crests are visible; there is no Golden Gate Bridge, Bay Bridge, Transamerica Pyramid, Salesforce Tower, Coit Tower, or cable cars.
top_issues.fix_hint: Place prominent 3D landmarks (such as the Bay Bridge or Golden Gate Bridge towers, Transamerica Pyramid, and Salesforce Tower) on the horizon line and ensure fog does not obscure them.

top_issues.issue: A modal 'DEPLOY WAYMO' overlay blocks the view at startup and delays driving, and the vehicle moves sluggishly while framerate drops to 14 FPS.
top_issues.evidence: Video 00:00-00:01 and Screenshot 0 show the modal blocking the screen; the car barely moves until 00:11 (maxing out around 23 MPH at 00:28), and telemetry shows FPS dropping from 37 down to 14 by step 7.
top_issues.fix_hint: Start gameplay immediately without a blocking modal overlay, increase vehicle acceleration and top speed for more exciting arcade driving, and profile/optimize rendering to maintain 60 FPS.

top_issues.issue: The cars are blocky, low-poly white boxes with a roof cylinder rather than sleek Jaguar I-PACE SUVs with realistic Waymo sensor suites.
top_issues.evidence: In Screenshots 1-5, the player and enemy vehicles have sharp rectangular box bodies without visible wheels from the rear, lacking the sloped coupe roofline, corner/fender lidar pods, side mirrors, and Waymo branding.
top_issues.fix_hint: Shape the car body with a sloped fastback SUV roofline, visible wheel arches and tires, black windshield/rear glass, front fender/corner sensor pods, and 'Waymo' door decals.

top_issues.issue: Street geometry and environment textures are overly simplistic and cartoon-like compared to real San Francisco streets.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 1-5 show flat grey road surfaces with oversized dashed lines, blocky low-poly trees (spherical green blobs on sticks down the hill), and un-textured flat-shaded building facades.
top_issues.fix_hint: Add realistic asphalt textures, detailed Victorian/Edwardian architectural trim, denser street clutter (traffic lights, street signs, parked cars, overhead trolley wires), and better tree foliage.

top_issues.issue: Extreme white fog/haze and bloom completely wash out the scene and ruin contrast, instead of delivering a clear sunny daytime look.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 1-5 and entire gameplay video (00:02-00:42) show buildings and sky bleached out by thick white fog.
top_issues.fix_hint: Drastically reduce fog density or push fog far distance much further back, lower bloom strength, and add a crisp blue skybox with strong directional sunlight.

top_issues.issue: No recognizable San Francisco landmarks (Golden Gate Bridge, Bay Bridge, Transamerica Pyramid, Salesforce Tower, Coit Tower, cable cars) are visible from the gameplay area.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 1-5 show only generic pastel rowhouses and distant blank white fog.
top_issues.fix_hint: Reduce fog so distant geometry is visible, and place prominent 3D models of the Bay Bridge, Golden Gate Bridge, Salesforce Tower, and Transamerica Pyramid in the background skyline and along the streets.

top_issues.issue: The Waymo vehicle model is overly boxy and blocky rather than having the sloped coupe SUV silhouette of a Jaguar I-PACE, and lacks side door 'Waymo' logos and wheel detail.
top_issues.evidence: Close-up of player and opponent cars in Screenshot 3 and video 00:19-00:24.
top_issues.fix_hint: Refine the car mesh to have a sloped fastback roofline, sculpted fenders, dark window glass, distinct wheels, and 'Waymo' branding on the doors while keeping the roof lidar and corner pods.
